question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, 
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN season5_matches s5 ON bbb.match_id = s5.match_id
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id,
           COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    JOIN season5_matches s5 ON wicket_taken.match_id = s5.match_id
    GROUP BY player_out
),
player_matches_count AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN season5_matches s5 ON pm.match_id = s5.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pmc.matches_played, 2) as avg_runs_per_match,
       ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pd.dismissals ELSE NULL END, 2) as batting_average
FROM player_matches_count pmc
JOIN player p ON pmc.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON pmc.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pmc.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY 1.0 * COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) / pmc.matches_played DESC
LIMIT 5

  1. Player name (text)
  2. Average runs per match in season 5 (total runs scored in season 5 / number of matches played in season 5) (decimal)
  3. Batting average in season 5 (total runs scored in season 5 / number of times dismissed in season 5) (decimal)
Ordering: ordered by average runs per match descending, top 5
